'''Larvit''' was an old retired [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that owned a [[Larvit's store|shop]] in the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] around [[3950 BBY]].
